Subject: Vendor enrollment and PO requirements for SummitTech

Hi Priyom,

We are starting vendor onboarding for Redwood ahead of the pilot launch. To create the vendor record in our AP system we need the following items from you: 
- Completed vendor enrollment form (we prefer a PDF)
- Legal name, W-9 (for US tax), or EU VAT certificate if applicable
- Remittance bank details and whether Redwood sends ACH or wire for collections
- A sample invoice that includes how you populate the PO reference (we require PO on every invoice)

Also: SummitTech requires invoices to include a 10-digit PO reference (format PO-#####) and a separate "Remittance" block with bank name, account ending, and SWIFT for international wires. Can you confirm whether Redwood will include our PO on your invoice header or line-item level?

If you can send the packet today we can create the vendor record and issue a test PO (we'll send a single test PO for you to reference on one invoice).

Thanks,
Michelle Liu
Senior AP Manager | SummitTech
michelle.liu@summittech.com

Hi Michelle — thanks for the clear note.

We can provide everything on your list. Please find attached our Redwood_AP_Onboarding_Packet.pdf and our Redwood_W9.pdf. A couple of quick clarifications:
- By default our invoices put the PO in the invoice header (Invoice: PO reference field) and also echo the PO on each invoice line for client clarity. If SummitTech prefers only a header-level PO, we can switch to that format without issue.
- For remittance, we do not include full bank account numbers in the packet PDF for security reasons; however, we will provide a remittance stub on the invoice (last 4 digits + bank name) and can provide secure bank details via encrypted portal or secure email to your vendor ops team.
- We included a short sample invoice template in the onboarding packet; if you need a specific sample referencing the test PO, we can send one once you issue the PO.

Laura Bennett (cc) is our finance lead and will own the bank detail exchange and any tax evidence.

Next steps from Redwood: 
1) Laura will provide EU VAT evidence (if needed) and a sample invoice referencing your test PO.
2) Priyom will follow up to confirm vendor portal integration options (CSV remit, SFTP, or vendor portal uploads).

Expect Laura's note shortly.

Best,
Priyom Das
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Hi Priyom / Laura,

Thanks — a couple of follow-ups from our side after a quick review of the packet: 
1) For redwood to be tax-complete in our EU operations we need either an EU VAT registration certificate or an explicit self-certifying treaty doc. Can you confirm if Redwood has an EU VAT ID for any entity that will invoice SummitTech?
2) Please send a one-page PDF showing the invoice header layout with the PO formatted exactly as you would generate it (we need to validate our AP parser). Example we need to accept: PO-73945 (10-digit style you referenced is fine but we parse PO-##### specifically).
3) For bank details exchange: we require either an encrypted DocuSign form or SFTP transfer to vendor-ops. Emailing full account details is not permitted.

If you can return the VAT certificate and a sample invoice PDF, we'll trigger vendor record creation and send you the test PO number later today.

Thanks,
